name: Net Idol no Chijoku Douga Haishin ~Fan to no Hamerare Inran Kouryuu~
original_name: ネットアイドルの恥辱動画配信 ～ファンとのハメられ淫乱交流～
source:
Tsutsumi Mimi is the alias of a high-school student from the countryside who goes to school by day and runs a web blog and podcast at night and on weekends. A self-proclaimed "Net Idol" who isn't very famous but has a small group of dedicated fans.

During one podcast, a fan asks her to move the camera left and right. She has no idea why he's making this request, but doesn't object to fulfilling it. After all, what harm is there from giving fans a glimpse of where she lives? She accedes to the request, and shows off what her room looks like.

Shortly afterwards, her blog receives another burst of irreverent comments and the podcast concludes without further incident. It was precisely at that moment that Mimi realised the everyday life she had taken for granted would no longer return...

[Adapted from the official website's game description]
translation:
堤美美是一名来自农村的高中生，白天上学，晚上和周末经营网络博客和播客。自称“网络偶像”，名气不大，但拥有一小群忠实粉丝。

在一次播客中，一位粉丝要求她左右移动相机。她不知道他为什么提出这个要求，但并不反对满足它。毕竟，让粉丝一睹她住的地方有什么坏处呢？她同意了请求，并展示了她的房间是什么样子。

不久之后，她的博客又收到了一阵不敬的评论，播客结束了，没有发生进一步的事件。正是在那一刻，咪咪意识到她习以为常的日常生活将不再回归……

【改编自官网游戏说明】
